title: sqlite3_blob_close() reads the connection after sqlite3_close_v2() freed it
object: the sqlite3 connection struct (sqlite3MallocZero: a plain engine allocation, not lookaside)
lifetime_ender: sqlite3_close_v2 with a blob still open makes the db a zombie; the finalize inside blob_close frees it, then sqlite3DbFree reads db->lookaside
reached_why: close_v2 returning 0 means the zombie path was taken; plain close returns SQLITE_BUSY and there is no UAF

layer_by_arm.default: malloc (the connection is not a lookaside object; lookaside is a field of it)

asan.why: the freed object is the connection itself, a plain sqlite3_malloc; only memsys5 hides it

2026-11-16 lab server x86-64, formal (re.notes: memsys5 hides the use after free from both tools (silent, exit 0). In SQLite as shipped and in the rewrite the connection is a plain malloc block, and both tools report the read 704 bytes into the freed 712-byte connection.
